Method of Attack: Encrypts files on all drives and volumes (both local and networked)
Creates multiple threads for encrypting files that do not end with .exe, .dll, or .lnk extensions
Uses Elliptic-Curve Cryptography (ECC) to generate master keypairs for decryption
Terminates processes and services to reduce the number of files locked by other programs
Enumerates and mounts volumes to encrypt files on these volumes
Deletes volume snapshots by resizing the allocated space for snapshots of volume shadow copies
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Office applications, email clients, browsers, backup programs, security products, and database servers
Attack Vector: Manual execution by operators with administrative privileges
Indicators of Compromise: NOKOYAWA_readme.txt in every directory included for encryption
